message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie content can vary slightly depending on size and variety:

| Size | Approx. weight | Calories |
|------|----------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g) | ~18 kcal |
| Medium (≈123 g) | ~22 kcal |
| Large (≈182 g) | ~27 kcal |

So if you’re eating a typical medium tomato, you’re looking at about 20–25 calories.
